address: 1 Queen Street, Auckland Central, Auckland, 1010, New Zealand
bio: Occupying the sort of acreage that only a hotel could provide – in this case the InterContinental – this bright, contemporary restaurant is equally suited to a business lunch with clients as it is a romantic dinner for two. If you have the time then consider the ‘Taste of Advieh’ menu, which provides a great all-round experience. From the on-view kitchen you can expect a mix of Middle Eastern and Mediterranean flavours, in dishes that are as vibrantly flavoured as they are colourful. Just be sure to start with Turkish pide and have the delicious duck leg shish.
